VeeValidate import.description:
Import a VeeValidate 4 API.

导入 VeeValidate 4 API。

body: const { defineField, handleSubmit, errors, isSubmitting, resetForm } = useForm({
VeeValidate useForm with Zod.description:
Drive a form from a Zod schema; defineField returns a v-model target and the props to bind on the input. Requires useForm from vee-validate, toTypedSchema from @vee-validate/zod and a Zod schema.

以 Zod schema 驱动表单，defineField 返回可 v-model 的值与需绑定到输入框的 props；需要 vee-validate 的 useForm、@vee-validate/zod 的 toTypedSchema，以及一个 Zod schema。

VeeValidate defineField.description:
Bind one field: v-model the first value and v-bind the second onto the input. Requires defineField returned by useForm.

绑定单个字段：第一个值用 v-model，第二个用 v-bind 绑到输入框上；需要 useForm 返回的 defineField。

VeeValidate field markup.description:
Render one field with its label and error message. Requires the field pair from defineField and errors from useForm.

渲染单个字段及其标签与错误信息；需要 defineField 返回的字段对，以及 useForm 的 errors。

body: const { handleSubmit, setErrors } = useForm({ validationSchema: toTypedSchema(${1:schema}) });
VeeValidate setErrors from a response.description:
Map a rejected submission onto the fields the server complained about. Requires useForm from vee-validate and toTypedSchema from @vee-validate/zod.

把被拒绝的提交映射回服务端指出的字段上；需要 vee-validate 的 useForm 与 @vee-validate/zod 的 toTypedSchema。

body: const { fields, push, remove, move } = useFieldArray('${1:links}');
VeeValidate useFieldArray.description:
Manage a repeatable group of fields; each entry of fields carries a stable key. Requires useFieldArray from vee-validate, under a useForm in the same component.

管理可重复的字段组，fields 的每一项带有稳定的 key；需要 vee-validate 的 useFieldArray，且同组件内已有 useForm。

body: const { value, errorMessage, handleBlur, handleChange } = useField(() => props.name);
VeeValidate useField in a wrapper.description:
Wrap a custom or non-native input as a form field; passing the name as a getter keeps it reactive. Requires useField from vee-validate.

把自定义或非原生输入封装成表单字段；name 以 getter 传入即可保持响应式；需要 vee-validate 的 useField。

VeeValidate Form component.description:
Declare a form in the template instead of the script. Requires Form, Field and ErrorMessage from vee-validate.

在模板而非脚本中声明表单；需要 vee-validate 的 Form、Field 与 ErrorMessage。
